claim_or_uncertainty: Which chill formulation best predicts blueberry dormancy release is not settled across types and climates
cultivar_difference: Bluecrop and Coville versus broader cultivar literature
climate_difference: Cold temperate versus warm fluctuating winter regimes
production_system_difference: Mostly deciduous dormancy; protected warm winters less validated
method_difference: Controlled budbreak assays versus model-comparability synthesis
possible_explanation: Model response functions differ and dormancy assays are not standardized
model_implication: Keep model choice open; track chill model identity and dormancy observations separately

claim_or_uncertainty: A given cumulative chill number cannot be treated as direct observation that endodormancy is released
method_difference: Temperature sums versus biochemical or budbreak measures
possible_explanation: Bud type physiological state and warm interruptions alter response
model_implication: Use separate ChillAccumulator and DormancyState contract

claim_or_uncertainty: Flower-bud differentiation may occur during harvest or after harvest and can have multiple flushes
cultivar_difference: Types and cultivars differ; ONeal is one cultivar
method_difference: Histological sampling intervals and stage definitions differ
possible_explanation: Photoperiod temperature shoot cessation and cultivar-specific growth flushes interact
model_implication: Do not use one fixed postharvest date or stage transition

claim_or_uncertainty: Reducing bud load may improve fruit size/quality while lowering per-plant production; effects vary among studies
production_system_difference: Mature field stands and commercial orchards
method_difference: Pruning severity and retained bud load are operationally different treatments
possible_explanation: Cultivar vigor crop load age and market objective alter trade-off
model_implication: Keep removed structures and intensity explicit; no universal pruning factor

claim_or_uncertainty: Evidence supports different source/sink pathways but few studies isolate identical amounts of reproductive sink removal with and without wood removal
method_difference: Interventions remove different tissues and alter light/canopy differently
possible_explanation: The intervention distinction is causal and operational, but relative effect size is not fully identified
model_implication: Separate event types in contract; effect parameters remain open

claim_or_uncertainty: Evergreen non-dormant and everbearing are overlapping but non-equivalent production/genetic labels
cultivar_difference: Commercial Florida SHB systems versus FL16-64 genotype
climate_difference: Warm Florida environment and controlled chamber
production_system_difference: Commercial management versus short controlled experiment
method_difference: System description versus genotype photoperiod experiment
possible_explanation: Leaf retention and bypassed endodormancy are distinct traits
model_implication: Use explicit system and genotype attributes; never set chill requirement to zero from label alone

claim_or_uncertainty: Earlier bloom does not necessarily result in earlier or greater commercial harvest
cultivar_difference: Misty and tunnel cultivars versus four Portugal cultivars
production_system_difference: Potted treatments high tunnel and temporary tunnels
method_difference: Bloom stage versus first/peak harvest outcomes
possible_explanation: Floret number fruit set frost and fruit development mediate the downstream consequence

claim_or_uncertainty: Tunnels can advance phenology but yield and quality can rise fall or remain cultivar-dependent
climate_difference: Georgia mild winter Mediterranean and continental European sites
production_system_difference: High tunnel unheated tunnel polyethylene and other covers
method_difference: Different control environments and outcome definitions
possible_explanation: Cover timing ventilation freeze exposure and pollination access vary

claim_or_uncertainty: Calendar days and thermal-time models both leave cultivar/site variation
cultivar_difference: Seven SHB cultivars versus local cultivar sets
possible_explanation: Stage definition temperature range fruit load and pollination differ
model_implication: Use cohort-specific origins and calibratable thermal kernels; preserve residual uncertainty

claim_or_uncertainty: The crop-wide climacteric/non-climacteric or ethylene classification remains disputed
method_difference: Respiration ethylene ABA and stage sampling are inconsistent
possible_explanation: Ripening pathways may vary and literature uses inconsistent definitions
model_implication: Do not encode universal ethylene switch or fixed ripening hormone rule

claim_or_uncertainty: Leaf-area-to-fruit ratio captures only part of source capacity and sink demand
production_system_difference: Field canes whole plants and bud manipulation
possible_explanation: Leaf health radiation reserves roots and fruit developmental stage are omitted by a single ratio
model_implication: Keep source and sink as separate states; proxy selection deferred to S2/S1 review

claim_or_uncertainty: Pollinator visitation, compatibility, seed set, fruit weight and maturity are related but not interchangeable
method_difference: Visits, seed number, fruit set and timing measured differently

model_implication: Use distinct pollination exposure, effective fertilization and fruit-set observations

claim_or_uncertainty: Rabbiteye and lowbush findings can inform mechanisms but not directly set SHB/NHB parameters
possible_explanation: Genetic background and chill adaptation differ
model_implication: Store blueberry type and prohibit silent cross-type parameter transfer

claim_or_uncertainty: Blueberry stage-specific upper temperature response is not sufficiently harmonized for a universal forcing kernel
production_system_difference: Field crop development versus greenhouse photosynthesis and high-temperature treatment
method_difference: GDD observations versus short physiology/control trials
possible_explanation: Optimal temperature may differ for bud development, photosynthesis, fruit growth and quality
model_implication: No default base/ceiling temperature in S0; retain source-specific candidate values

claim_or_uncertainty: Current crop load can affect current source allocation and later bud potential, but the carryover magnitude is poorly identified
